name: Izumo 4
source:
This is the latest game in Studio e.go!’s tactical battle RPG IZUMO series and the first since 2007 when they became Debonosu Works. Daichi attends Yakumo Academy with his sister Misora and childhood friend Honami, and is part of the local history research club. One chilly autumn day with the annual culture festival fast approaching, he was spellbound by a girl in the hallway who had very abnormal looks. Her hair was bone white and her eyes were blood red. She vanished an instant later like an illusion. He met her again the next day and was dragged into an extraordinary world.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/12/18/december-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

Izumo 4 is a collaboration project to celebrate the [url=/p242]Light[/url] 15th and the [url=/p709]Debo no Su Seisakusho[/url] 5th anniversaries.
translation:
这是Studio e.go!战术战斗RPG《IZUMO》系列的最新作，也是他们2007年更名为Debonosu Works后推出的第一部作品。大地与妹妹美空、青梅竹马穗波一同就读八云学园，并加入了当地历史研究社。

某个寒冷的秋日，文化节即将到来，他在走廊上看到一名外貌异常的少女：骨白色的头发，血红色的双眼。下一瞬间，少女如幻影般消失了。第二天，大地再次遇见她，并被拖入一个非凡的世界。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/12/18/december-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

《IZUMO 4》是为庆祝[url=/p242]Light[/url]成立15周年和[url=/p709]Debonosu Works[/url]成立5周年而推出的合作企划。
